caption: This shio broth ramen features a golden-yellow, clear, glossy soup with thin noodles and green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a subtly textured rim, it includes a halved egg, dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork, and pale yellow menma on a dark wooden table.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a pale white, with a slightly textured surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
